crossrefs.text: He is my steadfast love and my fortress, my stronghold and my deliverer. He is my shield, in whom I take refuge, who subdues peoples under me.
My salvation and my honor rest on God, my strong rock; my refuge is in God.
May the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be pleasing in Your sight, O LORD, my Rock and my Redeemer.
I will say to the LORD, “You are my refuge and my fortress, my God, in whom I trust.”
The name of the LORD is a strong tower; the righteous run to it and are safe.
And David sang this song to the LORD on the day the LORD had delivered him from the hand of all his enemies and from the hand of Saul.
Great salvation He brings to His king. He shows loving devotion to His anointed, to David and his descendants forever.”
being strengthened with all power according to His glorious might so that you may have full endurance and patience, and joyfully

groups.title: Kings, prophets and the house of David

crossrefs.text: Call upon Me in the day of trouble; I will deliver you, and you will honor Me.”
In my distress I called upon the LORD; I cried out to my God. And from His temple He heard my voice, and my cry for help reached His ears.
The eyes of the LORD are on the righteous, and His ears are inclined to their cry.
Out of the depths I cry to You, O LORD!
O Lord, hear my voice; let Your ears be attentive to my plea for mercy.
In my distress I cried to the LORD, and He answered me.
I will call upon the LORD, who is worthy to be praised; so shall I be saved from my enemies.
One thing I have asked of the LORD; this is what I desire: to dwell in the house of the LORD all the days of my life, to gaze on the beauty of the LORD and seek Him in His temple.
You came near and stood at the base of the mountain, a mountain blazing with fire to the heavens, with black clouds and deep darkness.
Clouds and darkness surround Him; righteousness and justice are His throneʼs foundation.
He rebuked the Red Sea, and it dried up; He led them through the depths as through a desert.
You will place them in a fiery furnace at the time of Your appearing. In His wrath the LORD will engulf them, and the fire will consume them.
At Your rebuke the waters fled; at the sound of Your thunder they hurried away—
Flash forth Your lightning and scatter them; shoot Your arrows and rout them.
At the blast of Your nostrils the waters piled up; like a wall the currents stood firm; the depths congealed in the heart of the sea.

As they fled before Israel along the descent from Beth-horon to Azekah, the LORD cast down on them large hailstones from the sky, and more of them were killed by the hailstones than by the swords of the Israelites.
In my distress I called to the LORD, and He answered and set me free.
You have not delivered me to the enemy; You have set my feet in the open.
You broaden the path beneath me so that my ankles do not give way.
He lifted me up from the pit of despair, out of the miry clay; He set my feet upon a rock, and made my footsteps firm.
Indeed, He drew you from the jaws of distress to a spacious and broad place, to a table full of richness.
He reached down from on high and took hold of me; He drew me out of deep waters.
He rescued me from my powerful enemy, from foes too mighty for me.
to the pure You show Yourself pure, but to the crooked You show Yourself shrewd.
He who has clean hands and a pure heart, who does not lift up his soul to an idol or swear deceitfully.
I have not departed from Your ordinances, for You Yourself have taught me.
Vindicate me, O LORD! For I have walked with integrity; I have trusted in the LORD without wavering.
With my lips I proclaim all the judgments of Your mouth.
Now therefore, my sons, listen to me, for blessed are those who keep my ways.
In this hope, I strive always to maintain a clear conscience before God and man.
They went out from us, but they did not belong to us. For if they had belonged to us, they would have remained with us. But their departure made it clear that none of them belonged to us.
May the LORD repay your work, and may you receive a rich reward from the LORD, the God of Israel, under whose wings you have taken refuge.”
He is the Rock, His work is perfect; all His ways are just. A God of faithfulness without injustice, righteous and upright is He.
For You, O LORD, are my lamp; the LORD lights up my darkness.
For in You I can charge an army; with my God I can scale a wall.
For the LORD God is a sun and a shield; the LORD gives grace and glory; He withholds no good thing from those who walk with integrity.
O LORD of Hosts, how blessed is the man who trusts in You!
Every word of God is flawless; He is a shield to those who take refuge in Him.
Finally, be strong in the Lord and in His mighty power.
Therefore take up the full armor of God, so that when the day of evil comes, you will be able to stand your ground, and having done everything, to stand.
I am the LORD, and there is no other; there is no God but Me. I will equip you for battle, though you have not known Me,
Not that we are competent in ourselves to claim that anything comes from us, but our competence comes from God.
Blessed be the LORD, my Rock, who trains my hands for war, my fingers for battle.
You have given me Your shield of salvation, and Your gentleness exalts me.
GOD the Lord is my strength; He makes my feet like those of a deer; He makes me walk upon the heights!
God is my strong fortress, and He makes my way clear.
The LORD is my strength and my shield; my heart trusts in Him, and I am helped. Therefore my heart rejoices, and I give thanks to Him with my song.
But the wisdom from above is first of all pure, then peace-loving, gentle, accommodating, full of mercy and good fruit, impartial, and sincere.
Now the war between the house of Saul and the house of David was protracted. And David grew stronger and stronger, while the house of Saul grew weaker and weaker.
The LORD lives, and blessed be my Rock! And may God, the Rock of my salvation, be exalted—
He subdues nations beneath us, and peoples under our feet.
to Him who gives victory to kings, who frees His servant David from the deadly sword.
Surely you will summon a nation you do not know, and nations who do not know you will run to you. For the LORD your God, the Holy One of Israel, has bestowed glory on you.”
so that the Gentiles may glorify God for His mercy. As it is written: “Therefore I will praise You among the Gentiles; I will sing hymns to Your name.”
He will build a house for My Name, and I will establish the throne of his kingdom forever.

And all the people throughout the tribes of Israel were arguing, “The king rescued us from the hand of our enemies and delivered us from the hand of the Philistines, but now he has fled the land because of Absalom.
